Primary Build And Break
Primary Build And Break

Program principles

Part-whole, one number at a timeEvery number is built and broken in order, from 1 to 10. Numbers are nested, so each one builds on the numbers before it.
Explicit and systematicSmall steps, with nothing asked before it has been taught. Number Structure is the worked example, and Transforming and Structure Review fade to students.
Twenty minutes a dayFive components each day, in the same order: the Day 1 and Day 2 pathways. The app presents everything; the teacher picks only the day.
Practice and centres are the teacher's choiceAs in UFLI, each lesson's practice pages and centres are ready beside the lesson, for the teacher to use when they choose.
